query:
SELECT 
  d.id, d.nome, d.condominioId,
  p.id as processoId, p.valorOriginal, p.valorAtualizado, p.juros, p.multa, p.honorarios, p.correcaoMonetaria, p.dataVencimento, p.status
FROM devedores d
JOIN processos_cobranca p ON p.devedorId = d.id
JOIN condominios c ON c.id = d.condominioId
WHERE c.nome LIKE '%Saboya%' OR c.nome LIKE '%saboya%'
LIMIT 20;
